create_boxnet_model: create a BoxNet model for 3D object detection with configurable classes, proposals, and voting
run_boxnet_forward_pass: run the BoxNet forward pass on a point cloud tensor and return detection end_points
compute_boxnet_loss: compute the BoxNet loss given end_points dictionary and dataset constants
dump_boxnet_results: dump BoxNet detection results to disk with predicted masks and dataset constants
test_boxnet_with_sunrgbd: test BoxNet end-to-end using the SunRGBD detection dataset with ground truth labels
